title: Construction of the spectral sequence of a filtered complex
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex, and let $F^\bullet K^\bullet$ be a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Form the bigraded differential object $A^{p,q}=F^{p+1}K^{p+1+q}$, with differential induced by $d$, and let $\alpha:A\to A[-1,1]$ be the componentwise inclusion $F^{p+1}K^{p+1+q}\hookrightarrow F^pK^{p+1+q}$. The filtered-complex spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence] is the spectral sequence associated to this injective morphism of differential bigraded objects; its differential on page $r$ has bidegree $(r,1-r)$, and its initial graded object is $E_0^{p,q}=\operatorname{gr}^pK^{p+q}$ with differential induced by $d$.
